excerpt: We report on a precision measurement of the parity-violating asymmetry in fixed target electron-electron (Moller) scattering: A_PV = -131 +/- 14 (stat.) +/- 10 (syst.) parts per billion, leading to the determination of the weak mixing angle \sin^2θ_W^eff = 0.2397 +/- 0.0010 (stat.) +/- 0.0008 (syst.
publisher: SLAC E158 Collaboration / Phys. Rev. Lett.
title: Precision Measurement of the Weak Mixing Angle in Moller Scattering
